# CoreFoundation

**Area:** [Foundation & CoreFoundation](../COVERAGE.md#foundation) · **Apple:** [CoreFoundation](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/corefoundation) · **Issues:** [`area:foundation`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Afoundation)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted, thin:** a headers-only module (`isim/sdk-src/Frameworks/CoreFoundation`).
- About 60 C functions inside Foundation (`isim/frameworks/Foundation/CF*.m`) work on the toll-free bridged Foundation classes.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| CoreFoundation strings, time zones, bundles (`CFString*`, `CFTimeZone*`, `CFBundle*` info dictionary and identifier; its resources: below) | 🟡 | ≤17 | the common functions binary SDKs call, over Foundation (toll-free) |
| CoreFoundation core types: `CFNumber` (create / get value / type / compare, infinities and NaN), mutable `CFArray` / `CFDictionary` / `CFSet` and their copies and accessors, `CFDate` and `CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent`, `CFError`, `CFUUID`, `CFCopyDescription`, `CFGetTypeID` per type, `kCFCoreFoundationVersionNumber`, `NSFoundationVersionNumber` | 🟡 | ≤17 | passthrough to the toll-free bridged Foundation classes (as on iOS; `CFUUID` is its own type, not bridged to `NSUUID`). Adapted: collection callbacks are not called, collections always retain their values (the `kCFType*` callbacks' behaviour: values must be objects); `CFNumberGetType` reports the storage of isim's `NSNumber`, which keeps every integer as 64 bits and every float as a double (`kCFNumberSInt64Type` / `kCFNumberFloat64Type`, where iOS keeps the type it was made with); the version numbers are isim's, increasing with the emulated iOS version and above every `…_iOS_*` constant, not Apple's exact build numbers. Tested (FoundationTest: test_foundation) |
| `CFGetTypeID` against the `…GetTypeID()` functions | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the type ID comes from the object's class; data answers `CFDataGetTypeID()`, Core Graphics objects their `CG…GetTypeID()`, Security's `SecAccessControlRef` `SecAccessControlGetTypeID()`, so `CFGetTypeID(x) == CFDataGetTypeID()` holds as on iOS. Tested (HelloKeychainObjC) |
| Run loops (`CFRunLoopGetMain` / `GetCurrent`, `CFRunLoopRun`, `CFRunLoopRunInMode`, `CFRunLoopStop`, `CFRunLoopWakeUp`, `CFRunLoopIsWaiting`, `CFRunLoopPerformBlock`, modes (`kCFRunLoopDefaultMode`, `kCFRunLoopCommonModes`, `CFRunLoopAddCommonMode`, `CFRunLoopCopyCurrentMode`, `CFRunLoopCopyAllModes`); observers (`CFRunLoopObserverCreate`, `…WithHandler`, add / remove / contains, invalidate, activities, order, context); timers (`CFRunLoopTimerCreate`, `…WithHandler`, add / remove / contains, fire dates, interval, tolerance, `CFRunLoopGetNextTimerFireDate`); version 0 sources (`CFRunLoopSourceCreate`, signal, schedule / cancel / perform callbacks)) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: over Foundation's NSRunLoop (`-getCFRunLoop` returns the same object; `CFRunLoopTimerRef` is toll-free bridged with `NSTimer`); observers are told every activity of `CFRunLoopRun*`, `-[NSRunLoop runMode:beforeDate:]` and UIKit's main event loop (entry, before timers and sources, before and after waiting for events, exit), as crash and hang SDKs expect; `CFRunLoopStop` ends the innermost `CFRunLoopRun*` (not UIKit's event loop). Version 1 (Mach port) sources are accepted and never fire. Tested (FoundationTest `cf_runloop_checks`: test_foundation; HelloDiagnostics, a hang detector on the main loop: test_diagnostics) |
| `CFURL` (toll-free with `NSURL`: `CFURLCreateWithString`, `…WithBytes`, `…WithFileSystemPath`, `…FromFileSystemRepresentation`, `CFURLGetFileSystemRepresentation`, `CFURLCopyAbsoluteURL`, `CFURLGetString`, `CFURLCopyScheme` / `NetLocation` / `Path` / `StrictPath` / `FileSystemPath` / `HostName` / `UserName` / `Password` / `QueryString` / `Fragment` / `LastPathComponent` / `PathExtension` / `ResourceSpecifier`, `CFURLGetPortNumber`, `CFURLHasDirectoryPath`, `CFURLCanBeDecomposed`, the `CFURLCreateCopy…` path edits, `CFURLCreateStringByReplacingPercentEscapes`, `CFURLResourceIsReachable`, `CFURLCreateFilePathURL`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: over NSURL and NSURLComponents; parts are still percent-encoded unless charactersToLeaveEscaped is given; paths are POSIX paths (HFS and Windows styles are taken as POSIX); isim resolves a relative URL when it is made, so `CFURLGetBaseURL` is NULL; file reference URLs are path URLs. Tested (FoundationTest `cf_url_locale_checks`: test_foundation; SwiftFoundationTest: test_swift_foundation) |
| `CFBundle` resources and executable (`CFBundleCopyResourceURL`, `…URLsOfType`, `…ForLocalization`, `…InDirectory`, the bundle / resources / executable / plug-ins / frameworks URLs, `CFBundleCopyLocalizedString` and the `CFCopyLocalizedString…` macros, `CFBundleGetDevelopmentRegion`, `CFBundleCopyBundleLocalizations`, `…PreferredLocalizationsFromArray`, `…LocalizationsForPreferences`, `CFBundleGetLocalInfoDictionary`, `CFBundleCreate`, `CFBundleGetAllBundles`, `CFBundleLoadExecutable`, `CFBundleGetFunctionPointerForName` / `DataPointerForName`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: a `CFBundleRef` is the NSBundle; resources are looked up like NSBundle (the bundle, then its preferred `.lproj`); symbols by name come from the bundle's executable (dlsym; the main bundle: every image loaded). Tested (test_foundation) |
| `CFPreferences` (`CopyAppValue`, `SetAppValue`, `GetAppBooleanValue` / `IntegerValue`, `AppSynchronize`, `CopyValue` / `SetValue`, `CopyMultiple` / `SetMultiple`, `Synchronize`, `CopyKeyList`, suites, `AppValueIsForced`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: over NSUserDefaults: the current application is the app's standard defaults, another application ID its suite, `kCFPreferencesAnyApplication` the global domain (and the search list falls back to it); user and host are accepted (one user, one host); no managed preferences. Tested (test_foundation, test_swift_foundation) |
| `CFLocale` (toll-free with `NSLocale`: `CFLocaleCopyCurrent`, `GetSystem`, `Create`, `GetIdentifier`, `GetValue` with every `kCFLocale…` key, `CopyDisplayNameForPropertyValue`, `CopyPreferredLanguages`, the ISO code lists, canonical identifiers, components to and from identifiers, character and line direction) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: over NSLocale (its keys are the same strings); quotation marks from a CLDR table of common languages; the exemplar character set is every letter. Tested (test_foundation, test_swift_foundation) |
| `CFDateFormatter` (`Create`, `CreateISO8601Formatter`, `CreateDateFormatFromTemplate`, formats and styles, `CreateStringWithDate` / `…AbsoluteTime`, `CreateDateFromString`, `GetAbsoluteTimeFromString`, properties) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: a `CFDateFormatterRef` is an NSDateFormatter (an NSISO8601DateFormatter for ISO 8601); a string is parsed whole. Tested (test_foundation) |
| `CFStringTransform` (and the `kCFStringTransform…` IDs) | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: isim's own transforms (Foundation's `applyingTransform`, see Foundation.md): Unicode normalization, removing combining marks or diacritics, Latin-ASCII, Any-Latin (Greek, Cyrillic, kana), Latin↔Cyrillic / Greek / Hiragana / Katakana, Hiragana↔Katakana, Fullwidth↔Halfwidth and XML hex, chained with ";"; Mandarin, Hangul, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai and Unicode names are not in isim (false, the string unchanged). Tested (test_foundation) |
| `CFNotificationCenter` (`GetLocalCenter`, `GetDarwinNotifyCenter`, `GetDistributedCenter`, `AddObserver`, `RemoveObserver`, `RemoveEveryObserver`, `PostNotification`, `…WithOptions`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the Darwin center is notify(3), so it reaches other processes ([DarwinNotify](DarwinNotify.md)); the local center calls its observers on the posting thread, filtered by name and object (NULL: any); the distributed center (macOS's) delivers within the process; suspension behaviours are accepted (apps are not suspended while they run). Tested (NotifyTest: test_notify) |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `CFBag`, `CFBinaryHeap`, `CFBitVector`, `CFCalendar`, `CFFileDescriptor`, `CFFileSecurity`, `CFFileSecurityClearOptions`, `CFGregorianUnitFlags`, `CFMachPort`, `CFMessagePort`, `CFMutableBag`, `CFMutableBitVector`, `CFMutableCharacterSet`, `CFNull`, `CFNumberFormatter`, `CFNumberFormatterKey`, `CFPlugIn`, `CFPlugInInstance`, `CFReadStream`, `CFSocket`, `CFStreamClientContext`, `CFStreamError`, `CFStreamErrorDomain`, `CFStreamEventType`, `CFStreamPropertyKey`, `CFStreamStatus`, `CFStringTokenizer`, `CFSwappedFloat32`, `CFSwappedFloat64`, `CFTree`, `CFURLEnumerator`, `CFURLEnumeratorOptions`, `CFURLEnumeratorResult`, `CFUserNotification`, `CFWriteStream`, `CGAffineTransformComponents` (36 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
